# Retaliation (`features:berserker-retaliation`)
**Class:** [Barbarian](../classes/barbarian.md) | **Subclass:** [Path of the Berserker](../subclasses/path-of-the-berserker.md) | **Level:** [Barbarian 10](../levels/barbarian-10.md)

When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
